question: Come to think of it, I feel like a white whale that appeared in some manga I saw long ago was super powerful. Does a white whale inherently have some powerful symbolism? I feel like it was from Weekly Shonen Jump, but I don't remember at all and searching brings up nothing, so it might just be déjà vu.
answer:
When you say White Whale, it's gotta be Moby-Dick!
Well, I don't know whether it was in a Jump manga or something, but speaking of the White Whale, it's Moby-Dick and Captain Ahab.
I believe this is the origin of the image of 'White Whale = mighty foe'; it was for me too.
